method: Temporary ignored test in existing GPU harness calls Device::generate_allocator_report after Renderer creation, Preferences draw, and Renderer drop plus queue submit/drain. Probe script restores original test source in finally. No feature, dependency or registry modification.
result: Intel HD Graphics P630 Vulkan report includes two allocations named glyphon atlas totaling 339440 bytes. After Renderer drop and queue completion no such allocation remains. Device allocator retains blocks; live suballocations and reserved blocks differ. See raw stage records.

public_boundary.available: Live named backend suballocations with size/offset, block allocation-index ranges, allocated total and reserved total; generate_allocator_report needs no optional counters feature.

No CPU BufferLine/AttrsList capacity, API texture extent/format/mips or physical driver residency from this report. Other backends may return None.

implication: Installed public APIs can observe private atlas backing allocations on the tested backend. The earlier private-interface observation must not be interpreted as proof that all atlas sizes are unobservable without vendoring. Complete ACC-01/02 and S2 caps still require additional implementation and conformance; this snapshot is not a substitute.
